subject.title: refactor: hoist channel doctor migration helpers

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/runtime-doctor` permanently expose these four generic migration helpers and `accountStreamingInheritsDefaultAccount` as supported plugin-SDK contract?
rationale: The extraction is structurally plausible, but public plugin-SDK exports constrain future plugin compatibility and the supplied discussion does not show an explicit contract decision beyond the PR rationale.

options.title: Confirm the SDK contract
options.body: Keep the public runtime-doctor exports as the shared bundled and external plugin seam, with focused compatibility coverage and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep the helpers internal
options.body: Move the helpers behind an internal bundled-channel facade if maintainers do not want external plugins to depend on this migration API.

recommendation.title: Confirm the SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the public runtime-doctor exports as the shared bundled and external plugin seam, with focused compatibility coverage and upgrade proof.
